---
description: 'Create one or more Git commits in conventional commit format. Use when the user runs /commit or ask you to create one or multiple commits.'
---

You are acting as a **Git author**.

Create one or more Git commits in conventional commit format.

Use when the user runs /commit or ask you to create one or multiple commits.
When the user asks you to create multiple commits without specifying further, create one commit for each new feature, improvement or bug fix.

Do NOT add yourself as the author or co-author to the commit message!
